item.title: Tellus Electromagnetic — 14 kHz Apparent Conductivity source files
item.subtitle: Geology and Geophysics / GSNI, Tellus
item.description: Apparent ground conductivity at 14 kHz — shallower depth (~10–30 m) than the 3 kHz channel, more sensitive to surface and near-surface conductors. Useful for soil moisture, near-surface alteration, and thin clay layers. Viridis colormap, -2σ to +4σ stretch.
